|translation='''Title:''' Vader.

'''Card text:''' Must deploy on the Death Star. After that he may move anywhere. May not deploy if two or more of the opponent's unique (＊) characters are on the table. If he takes part in a battle and loses, draw destiny. If destiny > 4, “choke” (lose) one Imperial personnel. You choose whom to lose.

'''Lore:''' The man who set out to destroy every last Jedi. Once Obi-Wan Kenobi's apprentice, he was drawn to the dark side of the Force.
